summary: Improve service standards, complaint escalation and performance oversight. Explore the five-day public service delivery management course.
lede: Public service delivery management training helps service managers, quality leads and supervisors oversee public-facing services. You will map service ownership, set measurable standards, establish complaint escalation routes and calculate performance indicators. Root-cause reviews and corrective-action planning help teams address recurring failures, while service-process controls, complaint records and scorecards support operational reviews and reporting to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals accountable for the operating controls, complaint pathways and performance oversight of public-facing services.
prerequisites: Recommended: experience overseeing a public-facing service, complaint process or quality-improvement activity. No programming is required; participants should be able to work with service records and basic spreadsheet calculations.
